turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you get a chance to review the new OKF spec updates? The draft for v0.2 just dropped.
I saw the notification. I haven't dug into the diffs yet. Did anything major change in the core schema?
Yeah, actually. It's a breaking change for the metadata section. OKF v0.2 supersedes the 'timestamp' field with 'generated: {by, at}' in section 13.1. We need to update our parser.
Got it. That nested structure makes sense for attribution. I'll make a note to check our ingestion logic for that specific field mapping.
Perfect. Also, unrelated, but can you check if my order for the mechanical keyboard switches has shipped? It's been three days.
Checking tracking now... It looks like it was marked 'shipped' yesterday evening. You should get a carrier update shortly.
Okay, good. I'm tired of typing on this laptop membrane. Thanks for checking.
No problem. Let me know if you need help with those regex patterns for the new 'generated' field later.
Lloyd, I'm trying to refactor the document generation pipeline. Can you show me the current implementation of the plan document handler?
Sure. I'm looking through the repository structure for the main handler class. Usually, this logic lives in `src/generators/`.
I was looking for `app/harness/plan_document.py` specifically. I think I left a TODO there last week.
I just ran a search on the current checkout. It turns out app/harness/plan_document.py does not exist in the Lloyd checkout. That path might be from an older branch or a different module.
Ah, that explains why the import was failing. I must have been looking at the legacy repo. Let's just create a new stub in the correct generator module.
Will do. I'll create `src/generators/plan_handler.py` with the basic stub you requested.
Great. Also, is it going to rain later? I want to walk the dog before it gets dark.
The forecast shows a 40% chance of showers after 6 PM. I'd suggest going now to be safe.
